summary: Roku disclosed in an 8-K that it and Fox Corporation each received a DOJ Second Request on September 8, 2026, in connection with Fox's pending acquisition of Roku under a June 14, 2026 merger agreement. The two-step merger structure makes Roku a wholly owned Fox subsidiary. The Second Request extends the HSR waiting period 30 days after substantial compliance, unless earlier terminated. Terms, price per share, and premium are not disclosed in this excerpt. Roku still expects closing in H1 2027, pending antitrust clearance and stockholder approvals; Roku's definitive proxy was filed with an S-4 declared effective September 1. Arbitrage focus: DOJ review timing and any divestiture demands.
